name: ielts-essay-reading-lab
description: 70 IELTS model essays in a VitePress document site, grouped by topic and question type

scripts.dev: npm run check:audio && npm run build:editor && node scripts/generate-docs.mjs && vitepress dev site --host 127.0.0.1 --port 4173 --strictPort
scripts.build: npm run check:audio && node scripts/verify-essays.mjs && npm run build:editor && node scripts/generate-docs.mjs && vitepress build site
scripts.test:vocabulary: node tests/vocabulary-browser.mjs && node tests/vocabulary-notes-browser.mjs && node tests/vocabulary-links-browser.mjs && node tests/vocabulary-marks-browser.mjs && node tests/vocabulary-stories-browser.mjs && node tests/vocabulary-story-progress-browser.mjs
